Today, Iranians mark Ferdowsi, savior of Farsi & celebrate Persian Language Day, recognizing his immense contribution to preserving their language & cultural identity.

Ferdowsi, born in 940 CE near Tous, is globally revered for his Shahnameh (Book of Kings), longest epic poem by a single author and a cornerstone of Persian literature.
